title: MiniDAQ acquisition configuration, schema version 1.2
description: Documents the format that minidaq::config::parse_config reads (Chapter 6; version 1.1 adds the UDP source of Chapter 9, 1.2 the coincidence sorter settings of Chapter 10, 1.3 the list-mode output of Chapter 12). The C++ reader is the authority; test_config.cpp checks that this schema and the reader agree on keys, enums and ranges. Comments are allowed in configuration files but not by strict JSON tools.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR. A reader accepts its own major version and minor versions up to its own.

rt_profile.description: Path of a real-time profile (Chapter 4); empty for none. Read when the configuration is applied.

stop_after_s.description: Stop after this many seconds of data at source.rate_hz; 0 runs until stopped. Synthetic source only.

udp.description: udp only (schema 1.1): the MDQ-R1 readout link of Chapter 9

sorter.description: The coincidence sorter (Chapter 10). The window is /pipeline/coincidence_window_ps. delay_ps must be 0 or more than the window; energy_low_kev must not exceed energy_high_kev.

output.description: Where the coincidences go (schema 1.3, Chapter 12). type none counts and discards them; listmode writes MDQ-L1 files <directory>/<prefix>-<UTC start>-<NNNN>.mdql (docs/formats/mdq-l1.md). directory must not be empty; prefix must be non-empty and contain no '/'.

max_file_mb.description: MiB per file before the next one starts

fsync.description: none: never; close: once per file, before the rename; interval: also every fsync_every_blocks blocks

buffers.description: blocks in flight between the encoder and the disk

max_block_delay_ms.description: a block is written at the latest this long after its first record
